app.name: Flipkart - Online Shopping App
app.description: India's largest online marketplace for electronics, fashion, home essentials and more, offering fast delivery, easy returns, and secure payments.

verdict.one_liner: Flipkart collects extensive personal data including government IDs and financial details, shares it broadly across its corporate group and with advertisers, and uses it for behavioural profiling and targeted marketing.
verdict.summary: Flipkart is India's dominant shopping platform, but its privacy practices are invasive. It collects government IDs (PAN, Aadhaar), credit reports, health data for prescriptions, and facial images for virtual try-on. This data is shared widely with Flipkart group companies, lending partners, advertisers, credit bureaus, and potential business acquirers. While it offers opt-outs for marketing emails and personalised ads, the default data-sharing footprint is extensive and hard to fully control.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The sheer breadth of data collection (government IDs, health records, facial images, financial details) combined with extensive third-party sharing makes this a high-risk app for privacy-conscious users.

red.title: Collects government ID numbers
red.plain_english: Flipkart asks for your PAN card, Aadhaar, or other government-issued ID numbers. These are highly sensitive documents that can be used for identity theft if leaked.

red.title: Accesses your credit report
red.plain_english: To offer loans and PayLater services, Flipkart pulls your credit information report from credit agencies. This creates a financial profile about your borrowing habits.

red.title: Shares data across corporate group and partners
red.plain_english: Your shopping history, contact details, and financial data are shared with Flipkart's sister companies (Myntra, Cleartrip), lending partners, credit bureaus, advertisers, and even potential buyers if Flipkart is ever sold.

red.title: Collects health data for prescriptions
red.plain_english: When buying prescription medicines, Flipkart collects your medical information and may connect you with third-party doctors. Your health data could be shared with these teleconsultation providers.

red.title: Stores facial images for virtual try-on
red.plain_english: The 'virtual try and buy' feature uploads photos of your face to Flipkart's servers. These images could be retained and used for purposes beyond just the try-on feature.

red.title: Tracks you across websites for ads
red.plain_english: Flipkart uses Google Analytics and third-party ad companies to track which websites you visit before and after Flipkart, building a detailed advertising profile about you.

red.title: Data sold in mergers or acquisitions
red.plain_english: If Flipkart merges with or is bought by another company, your personal data can be transferred to the new owner without requiring your fresh consent.

green.title: Has a dedicated grievance officer
green.plain_english: Flipkart has appointed a Grievance Officer with a physical address and email (privacy.grievance@flipkart.com) for handling privacy complaints, which is a legal requirement in India.

green.title: Marketing emails can be opted out
green.plain_english: You can unsubscribe from promotional emails and SMS through the Notification Preference page in the app.

green.title: Personalised ad tracking can be disabled
green.plain_english: You can turn off personalised ad tracking through your phone's device settings using the 'Opt out of Ads Personalization' feature.

green.title: Uses secure servers for transactions
green.plain_english: Flipkart claims to use secure servers and encryption when you access account information and make payments.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Flipkart accesses your camera and photo gallery for virtual try-on features and voice commands. Images you upload are stored on their servers.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly mentions camera, photo gallery, and voice command access. Virtual try-and-buy features upload facial images to servers.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you use voice commands or virtual try and buy or similar features to shop on the Platform, we will collect that information you provide to us.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Flipkart collects your location to personalise delivery recommendations and your shopping experience. This data is shared with business partners.
categories.detail: Location is explicitly listed as data collected with consent, used for personalising the user journey including delivery recommendations.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your... location... to enhance your experience on the Platform.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Flipkart accesses your contacts and SMS messages with your consent. This data is used for KYC verification and shared with lending partners and other third parties.
categories.detail: Contacts and SMS are explicitly listed as collected data, used for eligibility checks, KYC, and shared with affiliates and lending partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your SMS, instant messages, contacts in your directory... to check your eligibility for certain products and services like insurance, credit and payment products.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Flipkart accesses your photo gallery for uploading prescription images and virtual try-on photos. The scope of access is not clearly limited.
categories.detail: Photo gallery access is mentioned but no details on whether the app scans the entire gallery or only the selected photo.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your... camera, photo gallery...

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your data is shared extensively with Flipkart group companies, sellers, advertisers, lending partners, credit bureaus, and potential business acquirers.
categories.detail: The policy lists numerous categories of third parties that receive data, including for marketing, credit underwriting, and merger/acquisition scenarios.
categories.policy_excerpt: The insights derived from this analysis may be shared with our group companies... and third-parties who offer services to us... for promotions, advertisements and marketing.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Flipkart collects your name, email, phone, address, PAN, Aadhaar, government ID, KYC details, and credit report. This identity data is used for profiling and shared broadly.
categories.detail: Extensive identity data collection including sensitive government IDs and financial identity documents.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect personal data (such as email address, delivery address, name, phone number, credit card/debit card... PAN, credit information report, GST Number, Government issued ID cards/number and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) details...

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Flipkart tracks your browsing behaviour, buying patterns, and website visits using cookies, web beacons, and Google Analytics. This data is used for personalised ads and shared with ad companies.
categories.detail: Extensive behavioural tracking including URL history, browsing patterns, IP-based identification, and third-party ad tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect and analyse your personal data relating to your buying behavior, browsing patterns, preferences... The insights derived from this analysis may be shared with our group companies... and third-parties... for promotions, advertisements and marketing.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Flipkart says its platform is only for adults who can legally contract (18+). However, there is no active age verification system mentioned.
categories.detail: Age requirement stated but no technical enforcement mechanism described.
categories.policy_excerpt: Use of our Platform is available only to persons who can form a legally binding contract under the Indian Contract Act, 1872. We do not knowingly solicit or collect personal data from children under the age of 18 years.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Flipkart logs your IP address, the websites you visited before and after Flipkart, and your browser information. This is used to identify you and build advertising profiles.
categories.detail: IP address is used for both server diagnostics and user identification. URLs visited before and after Flipkart are tracked.
categories.policy_excerpt: This information may include the URL that you just came from (whether this URL is on our Platform or not), which URL you next go to... your computer browser information, and your IP address.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Flipkart collects your device information and uses your IP address to identify you and gather demographic data. This helps build a detailed profile about you.
categories.detail: Device info and IP address are collected continuously and used for identification and demographic profiling.
categories.policy_excerpt: With your consent, we may have access to your... device information... Your IP address is also used to help identify you and to gather broad demographic information.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: For prescription medicines, Flipkart collects your medical information and may share it with third-party doctors. Facial images for virtual try-on are also stored.
categories.detail: Health data is collected for prescription processing and shared with teleconsultants. Facial data collected for virtual try-and-buy.
categories.policy_excerpt: In cases where the prescriptions uploaded by you are invalid... we may, through third-party vendors connect You with medical practitioners, teleconsultants or third-party professionals...

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Flipkart stores your credit/debit card details, UPI ID, and credit report. It also offers loans and PayLater through partners, creating a financial profile about your spending habits.
categories.detail: Direct collection of payment instrument details, UPI ID, credit reports, and use of financial data for lending products.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect personal data (such as... credit card/debit card and other payment instrument details... UPI ID if you choose to pay via our Flipkart UPI platform.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can update some information in your profile, but deleting your account requires emailing Flipkart. Even then, some data is kept for fraud prevention and legal requirements.
categories.detail: Limited self-service deletion. Account data retained for fraud/legal purposes. Withdrawal of consent may restrict platform access.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may delete certain non-mandatory information by logging into our website and visiting Profile and Settings sections. You can also write to us... withdrawal of consent will not be retroactive... In the event you withdraw consent... such withdrawal may hamper your access to the Platform.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Flipkart updates its privacy policy periodically and says it will post a notice on the platform or email you when legally required. Continued use means you accept the new terms.
categories.detail: Passive notification method. Continued use constitutes acceptance.
categories.policy_excerpt: Please check our Privacy Policy periodically for changes... We will alert you to significant changes by posting the date our policy got last updated, placing a notice on our Platform, or by sending you an email when we are required to do so by applicable law.
